title.en: Validate documents against the schemas and read the errors for a broken one

goal.en: Every Cookwala document kind has a JSON Schema. The validate tool returns ok or a list of errors with the path of each one, so a publisher can fix a recipe before it reaches any device.

note.en: The shakshuka example passes the recipe schema.
A stub with an id that has spaces and a revision given as a word: eleven errors, each with its path.
A capability document is checked against its own schema.
The Core schema covers requests, statuses, logs, recalls and incident reports.

cli: cookwala validate   # every schema, example, vocabulary and API in the repository

outcome.en: You can validate any document kind over HTTP and read machine-checkable errors. The CLI form validates the whole repository, including recipe targets against operation envelopes. Next: scenario 025 shows a target outside its envelope.
